I moved to Waterloo in September for my first year and I didn't get into residence so I found a place on Facebook Marketplace near Columbia and Phillip, it's a five bedroom house with four other people I didn't know before, two of them are in engineering and one is in arts and one is a grad student. The house is kind of old and the windows are drafty but whatever, it was cheap compared to the purpose-built buildings.
